decisions.revision_requirement: Restructure to a shared-DEM branch: warpreproject -> (gdal:slope | gdal:aspect). Both reviewers held that slope output is not a valid elevation input for aspect; branching both terrain derivatives from one reprojected DEM resolves the semantic defect and simultaneously supplies the raster and branch P0 gaps.

Both merge upstreams must share one geometry family (buffer yields polygons, centroids yields points; merge requires compatible types). Revision uses two centroids branches into mergevectorlayers. Hard constraint: must not become operator-equivalent to admitted expert-v1-007 (buffer,buffer->merge).

process_rules_adopted.rule: Expert proposals with chain length >= 7 must carry draft_task_intent, output_constraint, and process_necessity at authoring time; proposals lacking them fail semantic review by construction
process_rules_adopted.motivation: expert-v1-008 was returned for exactly these three missing fields; the v1 authoring batch carried no task intent for any proposal, so the gap is systemic, not specific to 008

process_rules_adopted.rule: The deterministic rule for anchoring multi-sink / multi-output DAGs (which family and topology quotas a multi-output DAG may credit) is frozen as part of the v0.2 Gate 3 rebuild, not per-proposal; until frozen, multi-output DAGs enter supply with quota_credit_eligible=false
